Reviewed the complete current claim and association set: one ordinary implementation at src/inspector.rs::build_dynamic_trace and one TODO test, sage_meta::todo::crates_sage_inspector_inspection_balanced_traces; no N/A or ordinary test entries. Independently verified byte equality of current src/inspector.rs and service_spec.rs against the historical snapshots and unchanged claim, then reassessed the historical independent rationale against freshly inspected current fragments. All relied-on trace helpers are in the captured whole implementation file; additional architecture context is captured by review read.

The requirements are a balanced span for every tracked invocation, entry before memo lookup even for already-current reuse, and terminal closure on execution, validation, reuse, cancellation and unwinding. The ordinary consumer creates a stack node on QueryEnter, matches QueryExit keys, maps Executed/Validated/Reused/Cancelled explicitly, and attaches completed children to their dynamic parent or roots. attach_trace_node, trace_disposition, query_operation, normalization and unbalanced_trace_event are included in the initial whole-file fragment. Unmatched/mismatched exits yield recorder-error nodes; remaining open nodes are retained as Observed. This consumes lifecycle evidence but does not establish that the producer enters before lookup or always closes during cancellation/unwinding. The historical rationale is sufficient only with that limitation, not as a claim of end-to-end implementation completeness.

The complete associated test body contains comments only and no assertions. Its explicit TODO prerequisite is to associate and review cold, warm, edited, nested, panicking, and pre-fetch revision-cancellation evidence asserting balanced entry/exit and all four dispositions, plus accumulator traversal evidence for internal memo refreshes. This accounts for cold execution, warm/current reuse, edited validation, nested balance, cancellation and unwinding, including invocation paths not visible from this consumer. A missing reuse entry or unwinding exit would not be detected by this placeholder; neither its annotation nor a passing test run supplies that proof. Accept this existing explicit deferral, retaining TODO until that producer-level evidence is connected and reviewed. No immediate edits to the deferral accounting are required.

Own commands: review start with supplied instructions, source/JSON inspection and exact-byte comparison, review read of inspection.sage, and review record. No behavioral tests or cargo build were run by this reviewer and no Rust source was changed. Coordinator-reported suite/build execution (321 tests in the saved instructions; later task reports 331) is separate from this source adequacy assessment and is not represented as my execution.
